newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Giordano in talks on new China stores.
newsitem.headline: Giordano in talks on new China stores.

text.p: Giordano International Ltd said on Friday it was in negotations with certain Chinese enterprises relating to the establishment of new Giordano retail outlets in Beijing and Shanghai and the negotiations were in progress.

The casual wear retailer said in a statement issued through the stock exchange "there is no assurance that they (the negotiations) can be concluded or as to the exact terms and conditions of the agreement which may be entered into."

The company's executive director Jimmy Chan said in the statement that "all of the 11 Giordano stores in Shanghai which were all operated by franchises and which were closed in March 1996 have not reopened for business."

"However, other Giordano stores in China (both directly managed and franchised ones) have continued to be operated normally and there has been no adverse change to their general relationship with the relevant Chinese authorities," Chan said.
Giordano said it continues to view the China market with optimism and intend to continue with the expansion of Giordano stores in China.
Giordano shares were up HK$0.35 or 4.93 percent to HK$7.45 in early afternoon trade.
